entities.summary: James Roy Horner was an American composer and conductor. He worked on more than 160 film and television productions between 1978 and 2015. He was known for the integration of choral and electronic elements alongside traditional orchestrations, and for his use of motifs associated with Celtic music. James Horner was a composers & musicians from Los Angeles (1953-08-14, Los Angeles–2015-06-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
